tools.name: search_docs
tools.description: Search the AstroWay guides: authentication, credits, error codes, field formats, agent setup and every product page. Returns title, URL, section list and the argument to pass to read_doc. No API key needed. For "which endpoint do I call" use find_endpoint instead, which also gives the price.

tools.name: find_endpoint
tools.description: Find endpoints by subject and get, for each, the method, the URL, the credit cost, the required body fields and a link to its reference page. Covers all 770 operations. No API key needed, so you can price a workflow before you have one.

tools.name: read_doc
tools.description: Fetch one guide as markdown. Takes the `url` that search_docs printed, for example "/api-conventions/". Only pages in the index can be read.

tools.name: list_docs
tools.description: The whole guide index grouped by section, so you can see what exists before searching for it. Pair with find_endpoint for the API reference, which is listed by subject rather than here.
